steps.name: Opening
steps.narration: Every operation has problems. Equipment breaks... maintenance gets missed... and important issues? They disappear. Into texts. Into emails. Into conversations nobody follows up on.

steps.name: Dashboard
steps.narration: This is Relay. Your operational command center. Open issues. Escalations. Resolution times. Everything your team needs... in one place.

steps.name: Issue List
steps.narration: Every issue has a status. A priority. A location. And an owner. Nothing gets lost. Nothing gets ignored. The right person always knows what needs attention.

steps.name: Issue Detail
steps.narration: From the moment an issue is reported... to the moment it is resolved... every action is tracked. Every change is logged. Full accountability. Every time.

steps.name: Issue Intelligence
steps.narration: This is Issue Intelligence. Before your team even opens the ticket... Relay has already analyzed it. Likely causes. Immediate actions. Ranked solutions. AI that actually helps.

steps.name: SOP Connection
steps.narration: When an issue connects to one of your procedures... Relay flags it. Automatically. Stop fixing the same problem twice. Start fixing the process.

steps.name: Asset Management
steps.narration: Every asset has a history. Every breakdown... every repair... every pattern. Instead of treating each failure as something new... your team sees the full story.

steps.name: Analytics
steps.narration: Issue tracking is just the beginning. Relay turns your data into intelligence. Trends. Bottlenecks. Recurring failures. And how you compare... to your industry.

steps.name: QR Reporting
steps.narration: Place a QR code anywhere in your facility. A machine. A restroom. A dock door. Anyone scans it... describes the problem... and Relay handles the rest. No app. No account. Just a phone.

steps.name: Approval Intelligence
steps.narration: Routine replacements should not require a manager signature. Relay identifies the item... verifies the damage... checks your policy... and approves it automatically. Bureaucracy eliminated.

steps.name: Executive View
steps.narration: For larger operations... Relay gives executives the visibility they need. Health scores. Regional performance. AI briefings. The issues that matter most... always front and center.

steps.name: Closing CTA
steps.narration: Every issue gets an owner. Every action gets tracked. Every operation gets smarter. That is Relay.
